packageRules.description: FluentAssertions >= 8.0 switched to a paid commercial (Xceed) license; the repo no longer depends on it (migrated to vanilla xUnit assertions). Block any reintroduction/bump to a licensed version.
Moq was removed in favour of hand-written fakes (4.20's SponsorLink incident exfiltrated developer emails at build). Disable updates so it is not silently reintroduced.
